name: @wui-js/data
author: Sergio E. Belmar V. <wuijs.project@gmail.com>
description: WUI/JS Data Lib - Open-source JavaScript library of reference datasets (countries, time zones) loaded on demand from versioned JSON files.

scripts.prepare: test -d .git && exit 0 || (rm -f README.md && cp NPM.md README.md && cp -r src/wui-js/data/. .)
scripts.prepack: rm README.md && cp NPM.md README.md && cp -r src/wui-js/data/. .
scripts.postpack: rm -f README.md && ln -s docs/README-en.md README.md && ls src/wui-js/data/ | grep -vE '^LICENSE$' | xargs rm -rf
